set.body: Found by the Opus review of 90a126ad (model-authoring seam fixes), same bug class as seam R1. modules/hrf/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/hrf/Pulse.scala:86 computes math.floor(width / step).toInt + 1 with no cap; convolution precision is only checked finite/>0 (EventResponseConvolution.scala:87, HrfGenerators.scala:29). Fix: typed refusal above a documented cap (cf. FunctionalDiscretization.MaxTrapezoidIntervals), tests JVM+JS, mutation check. Also from the same review (nits): ConvolvedBasisOrthogonalization doc comment lines 29-32 should describe the rank-loss refusal as an invariant guard; columnIsZero redundancy note; trapezoid endpoint reuse halves kernel evaluations; consider CGS2 re-orthogonalisation (single-pass CGS leaves ~1e-6 cosines near the 1e-10 threshold).
set.title: Cap Quadrature.boxOffsets work: tiny convolution precision on block events overflows Int / huge allocation
